Title: Public preview: Azure Static Web Apps now supports deployment with Azure DevOps

Body.Content:
In addition to GitHub Actions, you can now configure Azure Pipelines for your static web apps in Azure Repos or other source control providers supported by Azure DevOps. The Azure DevOps task for Azure Static Web Apps intelligently detects and builds your app’s frontend and API and deploys the entire application to Azure. 

Azure Static Web Apps provides globally distributed content hosting and serverless APIs powered by Azure Functions. It also includes everything you need to run a full-stack web app, including support for custom domains, free SSL certificates, authentication/authorization, and staging environments. 

To get started, see our documentation.
